Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 16:9 2D game entrance foreground, transparent PNG, hand-crafted high quality pixel illustration with crisp textured pixel clusters, 1536x864.
Create a fresh Korean Joseon-inspired martial training hall entrance viewed straight-on from its stone courtyard. Richly detailed Korean hanok wood joinery and restrained charcoal-gray giwa tile roof with gently curving eaves, exposed rafters, thick natural brown timber posts, pale plaster side wings with Korean diagonal/comb-pattern wooden changho windows. Deep layered eaves across top. Pine foliage only at far edges, stone plinths and worn stone courtyard at bottom, a modest Korean buk drum left and wooden practice swords right. Daylight sky blue, pine green, warm honey wood and ivory hanji, peaceful but inviting, never pink/red dominated. Absolutely no cherry blossoms, flowers, lanterns, tasselled curtains, pagodas, torii, gold trim or ornamental frame.
Critical compositing geometry: large EMPTY rectangular doorway opening centered, from exactly x=24% to 76% and y=30% to 84% of image. This opening must be genuinely alpha transparent, with NO doors, NO background, NO black fill, NO inner scenery. Entire rest of image opaque up to edges. Structural posts immediately outside opening. Top 30% opaque timber lintel/roof. Bottom 16% opaque stone doorstep/courtyard. A simple blank broad dark timber signboard centered above doorway, around x=33%-67%, y=17%-28%, no border ornament, no text (lettering added in Unity). Attractive polished modern Korean 2D game background, atmospheric yet sharp. No characters, UI, lettering, watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite, opaque image, wide 16:9. Two adjacent rectangular Korean hanok sliding door panels, flat straight-on orthographic view, filling entire image edge to edge, equal width with vertical center seam at x=50%. Each panel has natural honey walnut-brown wooden joinery, upper 75% ivory mulberry hanji paper and traditional Korean diagonal lattice salmun (diagonal diamond wood lattice above a narrow comb band), lower 25% plain vertical dark wooden planks. Two small dark iron ring pulls near middle seam at 58% height. Clean restrained carpentry. Warm daylight, no vivid red. Fine crisp hand-crafted pixel art texture for a modern Korean martial arts 2D game. Absolutely no blossoms, flowers, painted motifs, gold, text, frame outside panels, scenery, characters, perspective or shadows outside object. These are functional sliding doors to a Korean martial training hall. No padding, no gaps, no rounded corners; fully opaque to all edges.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production 16:9 background for modern Korean 2D martial arts rhythm game, crisp detailed pixel illustration matching classic pixel characters. Scene is inside a Korean hanok martial arts training hall, viewed at standing eye level. Spacious worn wooden maru floor covers lower 40%, open central sparring area completely clear for animated characters. Strong asymmetrical composition: thick timber beams and deep eaves at top, left rear wall pale ivory plaster with Korean comb-and-diagonal changho windows, wooden staff rack and folded straw practice pads tucked far left. Broad open veranda on right looks across sunny stone courtyard to low gray giwa-tiled seowon building and windswept pine trees; blue mountains far beyond. A modest hanging practice rope at far right. Warm light falls diagonally across floorboards. Natural brown wood, ivory hanji, muted teal shadows, pine green, blue sky. Inviting and rich but calm. No characters, no freestanding central targets (added as separate sprites), no text, no UI, no ornate frames. No Japanese lanterns, torii, pagodas, cherry blossoms, gold ornament or festival decorations. Full bleed, fully opaque.
